general.rule: A path is in Realize_E(T_a,b^(ij)) iff its transition label word is a linearization over exactly a Xi labels and b Xj labels after Sigma_O^ij. Reverse-third-family moves are endpoint-path morphisms but are not members of that trace fiber.

smallest.reason: -t_k=t_i+t_j is frozen as carrier presentation only. Replacing two native positive-axis component labels by one reverse-third carrier edge would promote a carrier relation to a native vector identity, which is forbidden.
